meta.storeFilter: phase2: priority in {P0,P1} + extra roots, closure of FluidFX,ItemSoundSet,SoundEvent,TagPattern,ParticleSystem,ParticleSpawner,ItemReticleConfig,ItemPlayerAnimations
meta.boot: the vanilla CoreServer asset pipeline exactly like RegistryDumper: Options.parse([]) for the option set, inert HytaleServer/Universe stubs, the AssetRegistryLoader static initializer for the vanilla stores, the plugin-module stores and codec variants, the pack's CommonAssetsIndex.hashes and the pack mounted as a zip FileSystem; the asset files are collected with Files.walkFileTree (the vanilla mechanism)
meta.payload: each <Store>.bin is the exact uncompressed payload of packetGenerator.generateInitPacket(assetMap, assets): a byte[packet.computeSize()] filled by packet.serialize(MemorySegment.ofArray(bytes), 0). It is not framed (no packet id/length header) and not zstd-compressed
meta.indexOrder: stores follow the selected stores' inventory order; the keys array and the ids object are sorted lexicographically by key; ids are the numeric ids of the store's map
meta.missingPackets: selected stores without a packet generator in the Java server: ["BlockTypeListAsset","PrefabListAsset","GameplayConfig","ModelAsset"]
meta.packetErrors: selected stores whose packet generator needs an un-booted server module; the index entry carries packetError and has no .bin: ["BlockSet"]
meta.loadFailures: when a store (or a child asset store) had decode failures, the store entry carries loadFailures.failedKeys / failedPaths (pack-relative); child-store failures are prefixed with '<ChildStore>:'. Known gaps of the canonical boot: PrefabListAsset references the prefab store, which this dumper does not boot - PrefabReference.processPrefabPath -> PrefabStore.getAssetPrefabsPath -> AssetModule.getBaseAssetPack() throws NullPointerException because AssetModule.get() is null - so all 78 lists fail and the single block type that references such a list (ExamplePrefabPlacementBlock_Tree) is missing from BlockType; the non-P0 interaction/camera stores also report decode failures because their plugin codec variants are not registered. None of these change the block/fluid/environment ids, which match registries.json exactly
meta.deterministic: no timestamps and no absolute paths are written; the pipeline runs with a single common fork-join worker, so two runs are byte-identical
